name: Complete homemade pasta
description: I cooked pasta with salmon at home. Per serving I used 150 g cooked refined-wheat pasta, 150 g salmon, 200 g broccoli and 5 g olive oil, with a small pinch of salt and no added sugar. The consumed ingredients cost exactly EUR 5 per serving. Total food-related time including shopping, preparation, cooking and cleanup was 30 minutes, without overlapping tasks counted twice. Preparation was easy. I absolutely loved the taste. The overall dinner experience was pleasant.

name: Restaurant: expensive and exceptional
description: I ate dinner at a restaurant. My own share was EUR 48 including all mandatory charges, with no optional tip included. Total return travel and waiting took 45 minutes; eating time is excluded. Obtaining the meal was easy. I liked the taste. My plate had 150 g grilled salmon, 150 g cooked refined-wheat pasta and 200 g broccoli, with about 5 g olive oil, a small pinch of salt and no added sugar. The service was excellent and the overall experience was exceptional.
